section.div: Simulator for the pioneering TX-2 computer
GNU findutils - periodically synced from git.savannah.gnu.org
Support for VI modelines in Emacs
GNU CSSC - periodically synced from git.savannah.gnu.org
A set of tools for working with discs (e.g. DFS image files) and files from computers in the BBC Microcomputer family. Includes conversion between BBC BASIC and text.
